description: bits-ui's Dialog compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified dialog, field, button, input, label and separator wrappers and the dialog-demo (a form around the trigger and the content; Field.Group's @container field-group rules through the Blitz fork's container queries). Opened from the trigger by Enter, the content focused on its first input (its value from the Input's defaultValue through bind:value's start, the caret at the start); typing into both inputs, Tab through the content, Escape closing it with focus back on the trigger; reopened and closed by a press outside the content (on the overlay covering the page: `covered`); reopened and closed by Cancel. bits-ui's body scroll lock (overflow hidden, the scrollbar compensation), the portal, the open and close animations, aria and data-state attributes
